name: Hairpin fold
oneLine: A strand folded back on itself: a paired stem and an open loop.
howItWorks: When two stretches of one strand match, they zip together into a stem. The unmatched letters between them bulge out as a loop.
deeper: Hairpins are the most common RNA shape. Real folding is predicted by tallying the energy of every pair and stack.
sizeComparison: a 20,000th the width of a hair
simplification: Our fold uses a simple pairing rule, not a full energy model.
